lines.en: I'm half-transparent; I drift as I move.

lines.zh: 我用小小的躯体往前滑。
lines.en: I slide forward on a tiny body.

lines.zh: 我飘在离地半格的地方。
lines.en: I float half a block off the ground.
Damp follows me as I move.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪向有人的方向。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward where people are.
Like a breath, I drift by.
I seep bit by bit into the shadows.

lines.zh: 这具小身子，走路没声音。
lines.en: This small body makes no sound.

lines.zh: 砖面上的湿痕，跟着我走。
lines.en: A damp trail on the bricks follows me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，慢慢转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle you, turning half way.
I move lightly, like a breath.
I drift through a crack and head over.
I stop in the air and slowly spread.

lines.zh: 我的身体薄得像一层雾。
lines.en: My body is thin as mist.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一个靠近的活物。
lines.en: I wait for something living to come near.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，安静得看不见。
lines.en: Against the wall, I'm nearly invisible.
My shape keeps changing.
I breathe slowly, without lungs.

lines.zh: 砖上的湿痕是我的痕迹。
lines.en: The damp mark on the brick is mine.

lines.zh: 我不动，就只是一团潮气。
lines.en: Still, I'm only a patch of damp.
I hear footsteps in the distance.
This place is uncomfortably dry.
I slowly shrink into a small cluster.

lines.zh: 我在这里，又像不在这里。
lines.en: I am here, and yet not here.

lines.zh: 我凝在墙角，像一滴没落下的水。
lines.en: I gather in the corner like a drop that never falls.

lines.zh: 安静时，我能听见砖里的水。
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear water in the bricks.
You hold moisture; good.
I come to your face and look closely.
I can feel your breath.
I have no eyes, yet I see you.
The wall behind you leaks damp.
I come closer bit by bit, slowly.
You reached out; don't touch me.

lines.zh: 我的形状映在你眼睛里。
lines.en: My shape is mirrored in your eyes.
You are damper than you look.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边化成一小片雾。
lines.en: I thin into a little wisp of mist by your ear.

lines.zh: 你这么站着，是在等我吗？
lines.en: Standing there, are you waiting for me?
When I come close, you'll feel cold.
I was scattered, and I gather again.
That thinned me by a layer.
I tighten and guard my core.
I scatter into wisps and slowly merge.
Does it hurt? Perhaps it counts as pain.
I have gathered back.
I cling further off and hide.
My shape has shrunk a size.

lines.zh: 这没什么，我很快就恢复。
lines.en: It's nothing; I recover quickly.
Stop hitting; scattering tires me.
That thing holds damp; I want it.
I drift toward it slowly.
A little water is enough to keep me.

lines.zh: 你举着的，是给我喝的吧？
lines.en: What you're holding up — is it for me to drink?
I'm close now; don't step back.
The smell is faint, but inviting.
I extend a wisp and taste first.
With moisture, I won't chase you.
I draw this in.
This little body is parched.
You passed right through me.
I have little substance; you can't hit me.
I'm against you; feeling cold?
I spread apart and you grasp air.
I brush lightly past your arm.

lines.zh: 这具身体，碰了也只是潮。
lines.en: Touch this body and it's only damp.
I draw back a little to let you pass.
You stepped on my edge.
I hug the floor around your feet.
We make no sound colliding.
Another patch of damp approaches.
We merge into a larger mass.
Two mists meet in a brick crack.
Our edges melt together.

lines.zh: 这地方够潮，适合留下后代。
lines.en: This place is damp enough for offspring.

lines.zh: 我们缓慢地交换着湿气。
lines.en: We trade damp slowly.
I feel less alone.
We cling to the wall together.

lines.zh: 湿热的地方，才适合我们。
lines.en: Only warm damp suits us.

lines.zh: 分开的时候，我也带走一点它。
lines.en: When we part, I carry a little of it.
I wrap it and draw from it slowly.
I'll take this bit of water.
I have no hands; I can only wrap.
I lift it into the air.
It seeps slowly into me.
I hide it in a brick crack.
This find leaves me damper.
I curl my edge around it.
I drew half of it out.
I'll keep what remains.
That thing is alive.
I lock on to its breath.

lines.zh: 我是一小团湿的龙息，别吸。
lines.en: I am a damp wisp of dragon breath; do not inhale.
This body is small, but I'm quick.
The target is only steps away.
I want the moisture in it.
I hug the ground and go around.
It hasn't noticed me.
I've decided; that one.

lines.zh: 那团热气在动，我闻到了。
lines.en: That warm breath is moving; I smell it.
I gather at its feet.
The air it breathes out is my clue.
I circle it, seeking a gap.
This body can bite as well.
I press closer.
It moves, and I follow.
I hide in its shadow.
One more step is enough.
I flatten my body thin.
It's starting to see the damp trail.

lines.zh: 我把身体对折，薄到只剩潮湿。
lines.en: I fold my body until only dampness is left.
This angle is best for striking.
A breath-made thing, clotting clump by clump.
It won't get far.
I press slowly onto its back.
Wherever it turns, I slip aside.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉成一条细线。
lines.en: I stretch my body into a thin line.
Its skin is beading with sweat.
When it opens its mouth, I'll enter.
I slip into its mouth and nose.
Damp wraps around its face.
I tighten suddenly and constrict it.
It coughs hard.
I cling to it and draw off the moisture.

lines.zh: 它被自己的呼吸噎住了。
lines.en: Its own breath chokes it.
I seep through its skin bit by bit.
This blow is one you can't see.
It's growing dizzy.
I loosen slowly and watch it fall.
I rush into its windpipe.
I wrap around its eyes.

lines.zh: 它在原地转圈，抓不到我。
lines.en: It spins in place, unable to catch me.

lines.zh: 我吸走它脸上的一层水。
lines.en: I draw a film of water from its face.
I condense on the wet brick.
The air damps and I appear.
Moist Dragon Breath, here.
I take shape from a single breath.
This small patch of damp is me.

lines.zh: 我一出现，砖就开始渗水。
lines.en: As I appear, the bricks begin to weep.
I drift, spread, and gather.

lines.zh: 这屋子里的空气变重了。
lines.en: The air in this room has grown heavy.
Small as I am, I can still wound.
Do you smell that damp?
I came without feet.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里慢慢渗出来。
lines.en: I seep slowly out of the shadow.
I'm here, and no one sees clearly.
This much damp is enough to move.
I hug the wall and wait for you.
The damp arrives first; I follow.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我整团都在蒸发。
lines.en: Fire makes my whole mass evaporate.

lines.zh: 我被摔到地上，摊成一片。
lines.en: I'm thrown to the ground and spread flat.

lines.zh: 水太满了，我整个人被冲散。
lines.en: Too much water, and I'm washed apart.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹成一团乱雾。
lines.en: The blast blows me into ragged mist.

lines.zh: 那支箭穿过去，带走了我一角。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and takes a corner of me.

lines.zh: 这种光把我照得几乎透明。
lines.en: This light makes me nearly transparent.
Too dry; I can barely hold together.

lines.zh: 一道雷下来，我抖成碎点。
lines.en: A bolt strikes and I shake into flecks.

lines.zh: 虚空中没有水分，我在散。
lines.en: No moisture in the void; I'm scattering.
